mapper.select: SELECT A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_NO AS MEMBERSHIP_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE AS MEMBERSHIP_TYPE, B.MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL AS MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL, B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRATION_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRATION_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_SUBSCRIPTION_FL AS MEMBERSHIP_SUBSCRIPTION_FL, (TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE) - TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE)) || '일' AS REMAINING_DAYS, (SELECT C.MEMBERSHIP_NAME FROM MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL C WHERE C.MEMBERSHIP_NO = B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE) AS MEMBERSHIP_NAME, (SELECT C.MEMBERSHIP_CONTENT FROM MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL C WHERE C.MEMBERSHIP_NO = B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE) AS MEMBERSHIP_CONTENT FROM EMPLOYER A JOIN MEMBERSHIP B ON A.EMPLOYER_NO = B.EMPLOYER_NO WHERE A.EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND B.MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N'
